what: The synthetic cast of the Cinco Chaminés demonstration (a made-up example), v0.1, 18 November 2026. Format: the storyboards cast.json format (storyboards.sgit.ai), so 'look' can be drawn by the storyboard kit or by sim/figure.js; plus 'side' (visitor or admin) and 'record' (synthetic-user profile fields: situation, the question they arrive with, what they know and do not know, what they decide on, what makes them leave, patience, screen). Every person here is invented: a test instrument, never a real guest, never evidence about real visitors. No real person or composite is modelled. 'prop_proposal' names a prop drawn by sim/figure.js.

characters.name: The Okafor-Hartleys
characters.role: the family from Manchester: two parents, two children aged 7 and 11, one week at half term
characters.stands_for: families who book once a year, months ahead, and compare everything
characters.personality: organised, price-conscious, reads every line about pools and stairs
characters.wants: a safe week with a pool and a beach within a short drive
characters.fears: a home that is not as pictured, and two bored children in the rain

record.situation: planning the October half-term week from a laptop at the kitchen table
record.arrives_with: which home sleeps four, has a safe pool and is near a sandy beach
record.knows: the dates, the budget, that Faro is the airport
record.does_not_know: what a tourist tax is, that IPMA forecasts only five days ahead
record.decides_on: total price for the week including fees and tax; pool safety; beds
record.leaves_when: the total is hidden until the last step, or no fence is mentioned

behaviours: asks the agent about the pool fence
characters.likely_complaint: the tourist tax was not in the first price shown
characters.expected_journey: home list, The Hill House, price for 7 nights, rules, events for children, book
